title: Husband and Wife
definition: Husband and wife refers to the unique roles, responsibilities, and partnership God establishes within marriage for mutual support, service, and spiritual growth.
summary: God designed husbands and wives to complement and support one another within marriage. Scripture calls husbands to love sacrificially, lead with humility, and care for their wives. Wives are called to support, respect, and partner with their husbands in serving God. Both are equal in value before God and are called to reflect Christlike character in their relationship. Healthy marriages flourish when both spouses pursue Christ together.
christFocus: Christ's sacrificial love for the Church provides the model for husbands, while the Church's devotion to Christ provides a picture of faithful partnership and unity.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many marriages struggle because spouses approach marriage from selfish expectations rather than biblical principles. Understanding God's design helps couples build stronger, healthier, and more God-honoring relationships.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Focus first on becoming the spouse God calls you to be rather than constantly evaluating your spouse's shortcomings. Pray together, study Scripture together, communicate honestly, and pursue unity through humility and grace.
